fields.description_1: Blenco needed a website that made custom window decoration easier to understand and order. Before buying, customers need information about materials, styles, measurements, rooms, and practical use. Too many choices can feel overwhelming, while too little information creates doubt. The website had to guide decisions without limiting comparison.
fields.description_2: I structured the website with clear categories, useful product descriptions, and visuals for each type of window decoration. Visitors can compare options based on room, look, and function. This makes it easier to choose the right product and place an order through a smooth, easy-to-navigate experience.

fields.description_1: C10 Media required content that would seem simpler and more comparable in their project. The page needed to describe the work of the agency using simple language, yet provide visitors with enough information about the service offered, allowing them to judge whether to contact the agency or not.
fields.description_2: I structured the page around what visitors need to see first: the offer, the benefit, and the next step. More concise sections, clearer language, and a focused WordPress layout make the agency website easier to understand and more ready for inquiries.

fields.description_1: Administratiegids needed to make comparing financial services easier for entrepreneurs who want practical guidance instead of technical explanations. Visitors had to understand whether a service matched their situation, what kind of support was available, and how they could ask a question.
fields.description_2: The website was designed to feel clear, calm, and informative without becoming too heavy. It presents comparison content in a structured way, so visitors can move naturally from orientation to interest. The design supports quick understanding while still leaving room for deeper information when needed.

fields.description_1: The most crucial issue faced by Miamicarwash was how to ensure the offer could be communicated in just a few seconds. The company had to give details about what their products were, their target market, and the reason why reaching out to them would be good for people.
fields.description_2: Through the transformation of automotive stories into a well-structured story with a good hook and appropriate service details, the WordPress design ensures that all the information is made accessible and comprehensible not only from a desktop computer but also through the use of a smartphone. There will be no doubts anymore.

fields.description_1: The Need for Transport Page in the Case of Taxi Centrale Rijswijk became necessary as the tourists would need to get an understanding of the type of proposal they had to make contact with the company. There was some structure missing in the narrative presented, besides there was too much use of generalized statements.
fields.description_2: It has been designed on the basis of sections which are easier to comprehend and also provide good-quality English language writing material for use in WordPress blocks. It provides an overview of the effort involved and its importance, and what actions can be taken by the visitors.

fields.description_1: When it comes to the Vanbachfinance example, it should be noted that the main challenge was to present the offer in such a way that the reader would understand its essence within only two seconds. The most crucial part was to highlight its features, for whom it was intended, and why people need to contact the company.
fields.description_2: The finance article was streamlined to make it simpler, starting with the introduction, services sections, and ensuring that relevant details were placed near the right actions. The design on the WordPress platform allows for quick scans of the site from either desktop or mobile devices, helping people determine whether or not they need to contact Vanbachfinance.

fields.description_1: Werken bij Alpina Drive needed more focused content, because the key recruitment information was not immediately clear. The page needed a stronger introduction, smoother transitions between sections, and straightforward wording that explains the offer before visitors decide to make contact.
fields.description_2: I reorganised the page with clearer formatting, stronger content sections, and a more logical flow from start to finish. The recruitment story now avoids unnecessary detail, helps visitors compare the opportunity more easily, and keeps the WordPress design consistent across different screen sizes.

fields.description_1: The primary task for SoDrive Académie involved communicating its educational offer clearly within a few seconds. The webpage had to communicate what services were offered, who they were intended for, and why one should get in touch. This would make the communication more precise.
fields.description_2: The education story was then simplified to have an attention-grabbing introduction, clearly outlined services with practical information closer to where action is needed. The WordPress design allows fast scanning from both desktop and mobile devices, making it easier for the website visitor to know what is being offered by SoDrive Academie. Contact was essential.

fields.description_1: Furkan Educatie needed an education page that makes the offer understandable from the first screen. Visitors had to see what is being offered, who it is for and why they should continue reading or get in touch.
fields.description_2: I rewrote the content into clearer sections with a stronger flow from introduction to action. The WordPress page now explains the education offer in plain language, supports quick scanning and helps visitors move towards contact with more confidence.
